title: Work-queue card is stale because the register is: 33 of 38 in_flight rows untouched >48h, dispatched lanes left queued, no terminal row in 45h
note: [SYSTEM-AUDIT-INTEGRATION F7, docs/audits/2026-11-04-system-integration.md] MEASURED 2026-11-04 ~18:27Z: GET /api/bot/work/snapshot served 1273 rows (main had 1274; treeState synced, so the VM pull is NOT the cause). in_flight 38, of which 33 updated >48h ago (median 79h, 4 >7d); newest done/dropped row ML-ENTRY-RISK-META 2026-11-02T21:22Z; 9 of 1274 rows updated in the last 24h. This lane's own row read state=queued lane=null at 18:18Z while the lane was running (manager SKILL step 3 'set in_flight on dispatch' not applied). Recurrence: AUD-20261019-STALE-INFLIGHT counted 32 on 10-28 and was dropped in the 10-29 bulk reset. FIX (Tier 1): (a) manager sweep now: every in_flight row checked against get_session, set to queued/landed_unproven/done with a reason; (b) dispatch writes in_flight in the same push as create_session; (c) /work/snapshot adds per-row ageHours and a staleInFlight count so the card shows its own staleness. DETECTOR: snapshot staleInFlight == 0 rows >48h without a live lane, re-run daily. [2026-11-04T20:06Z lane session_01AFoLuLCbQTSU5jK9dbmcvU] Design step 5: build owner_liveness.py's main() first (AUD-20261104-OWNER-LIVENESS-ZOMBIE), then /work/snapshot staleInFlight reads from it. Deep audit C6 agrees: >=20 of 39 in_flight unsupported. [2026-11-05 lane session_01AFoLuMS3KAfkdSSB4xiqmg] (a) DONE. Re-measured 09:2xZ on main 4dc63b2e2: checklist rows=1348 (1349 files incl. header), in_flight 41, of which 19 >48h since updated_at (the 33/38 of 11-04 had since fallen as other work moved). All 19 given a true state from PR state (get) + lane get_session + on-main artifacts, none dropped: done 5 (COUNTERFACTUAL-EVERYWHERE, DESK-LIFECYCLE-S0, RESEARCH-OPS x2, RESET-PROTOCOL), landed_unproven 9 each with observe, queued 5. After: staleInFlight=0 of in_flight=22 (python3 scripts/ops/stale_in_flight.py). Detector built: scripts/ops/stale_in_flight.py (report-only, importable stale_in_flight(); same updated_at definition WSD-S5 will serve). NOT built: (b) dispatch-sets-in_flight and (c) snapshot ageHours/staleInFlight = WSD-S5-STATE-VIEWS. Caveats: 22 rows not >48h were not liveness-checked; 3 owner-less lanes (RESET-PROTOCOL etc.) judged from artifacts not sessions; the 11-04 'no terminal row in 45h' not re-measured.
